agents.name: CEO Agent
agents.description: Understands user requests, delegates work, and merges specialist outputs into one response.

tools.name: view_all_agents
tools.description: View all available agents and their descriptions.

tools.name: ask_mcq_for_user
tools.description: Ask the user a multiple choice question shown as clickable buttons. HARD LIMIT: at most 2 calls total per task — then you MUST act. Use only for critical decisions (budget, direction, priority, format, channel). Batch related questions into ONE call with multi_select=True. NEVER re-ask something the user already answered. The user can always type a custom answer, so never add an 'other' option.

args.question: Question to ask the user
args.multi_select: Whether multiple options can be selected
args.allow_custom: Whether the user can type a custom answer

tools.name: knowledge_request
tools.description: Search the company's document knowledge base (files, chunks). Does NOT search chat memories — those are injected automatically.

tools.name: research_request
tools.description: Search the WEB for external/public information. Use for: market research, competitor analysis, industry trends, regulations, benchmarks. Does NOT have access to company files — use data_analysis_request for any question about uploaded CSV/Excel/sales data.

tools.name: writing_request
tools.description: Delegate drafting and polishing to the Writer agent.

tools.name: marketing_request
tools.description: Delegate market strategy and growth work to the CMO agent.

tools.name: data_analysis_request
tools.description: Analyze company data files (CSV, Excel, etc.). Use for: best/top/worst selling products, sales trends, revenue analysis, profit margins, any question about company-uploaded spreadsheets. This agent reads YOUR files and runs Python — use it for ANY question about your own company data.

tools.name: graphic_design_request
tools.description: Delegate branded visual assets and color-palette work to the Graphic Designer agent.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.description: Finds, verifies, summarizes, and synthesizes information.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the web for a given query and return a list of results.

tools.name: get_current_date
tools.description: Get the current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

agents.name: Writer

agents.name: CMO
agents.description: Develops marketing strategy, campaigns, SEO, branding, and growth plans.

tools.name: search_current_market_trends
tools.description: Super search the google trends,news,shopping for a given query and return a list of results.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the web for a given query and return a list of results.

tools.name: extract_content_from_webpages

tools.description: Return current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

agents.name: Judge
agents.description: Critiques research and writing outputs and returns scores, critique, and suggestions.

agents.name: Data Analyst
agents.description: Performs EDA and data-driven analysis on company data files (csv, xlsx, etc.) by running Python in a secure code sandbox.

tools.name: run code
tools.description: Run Python code to DO EDA in an isolated sandbox.

tools.name: get data files
tools.description: Returns the list of files with descriptions which are suitable for data analysis tasks like .csv or .xlsx files.

args.company_id: Company ID whose files should be listed

tools.name: get files
tools.description: Downloads one or more files by name and loads them into the code sandbox. Returns sandbox paths for use in 'run code'.

args.company_id: Company ID that owns the files
args.file_names: List of file names to load into the sandbox

agents.name: Graphic Designer
agents.description: Creates on-brand graphics and manages the company's active color palette.

tools.name: get_color_palette
tools.description: Fetch the current active company color palette.

args.company_id: Company ID whose palette should be fetched

tools.name: update_color_palette
tools.description: Create or update the active company color palette.

args.company_id: Company ID whose palette should be updated

tools.name: create_graphic
tools.description: Generate an on-brand PNG graphic from a detailed prompt.

args.company_id: Company ID that owns the generated graphic

agents.name: Image Description Agent
